topic_summary: Analysis of Deferential Realism's codified ontology (mountains, ropes, tangled_ropes, snares, scaffolds, pitons) as itself a contested kernel. The framework claims to diagnose structural constraints objectively, but different interpretive communities read its authority structure differently: as an immutable analytical tool grounded in observational rigor versus as a rhetorical scaffold adaptable to policy advocacy goals. This is an epistemic kernel contest testing whether the framework's own constraint typology resists or absorbs interpretive drift.

key_entities: Deferential Realism ontology (the codified constraint typology: mountain, rope, tangled_rope, snare, scaffold, piton)
Structural diagnostic interpretation (reading the framework as immutable observational tool)
Rhetorical scaffold interpretation (reading the framework as malleable advocacy device)
UKE Protocol Suite (the institutional apparatus claiming interpretive authority)
Policy advocacy communities (users seeking normative leverage from the framework)
key_tensions: Immutability vs adaptability (strict typology versus context-dependent application)
Observational grounding vs normative framing (descriptive constraint versus prescriptive rhetoric)

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The Deferential Realism constraint ontology as a fixed classification system for structural forces
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: UKE Protocol Suite's claim to adjudicate legitimate constraint identification through codified typology and extractiveness metrics
commitment_system_recognition.candidate_pattern: Interpretive Tradition (founding text with evolving interpretive layer)

readings.commitment: The constraint typology is an observational instrument with fixed referents—mountains are physical invariants, snares are measurable extraction mechanisms, and misclassification is an error correctable through better observation
readings.authority_grounding: Empirical falsifiability: the framework's legitimacy derives from its correspondence to measurable structural deltas and extractiveness values that exist independently of framing
readings.expected_structural_delta: High suppression of alternative framings; classification disputes resolved by appealing to observable metrics; epsilon values treated as discoverable rather than constructed

readings.commitment: The constraint typology is a normative vocabulary for policy critique—'snare' is not discovered but declared when a mechanism serves illegitimate beneficiaries, and the framework's value lies in its persuasive power
readings.authority_grounding: Pragmatic effectiveness: the framework's legitimacy derives from its ability to make structural critique legible and actionable in policy discourse, independent of whether classifications map to observer-independent facts
readings.expected_structural_delta: Low suppression of alternative framings; classification is advocacy-driven; epsilon values are constructed through normative judgment rather than discovered through measurement

readings.commitment: The constraint typology has a fixed core (mountains, ropes) grounded in physical and coordination constraints, but contested periphery (tangled_ropes, snares) where classification depends on normative judgments about legitimate beneficiaries
readings.authority_grounding: Stratified realism: the framework's legitimacy is domain-dependent—empirical authority for physical/coordination constraints, interpretive authority for entanglement/extraction claims
readings.expected_structural_delta: Medium suppression; core classifications stable across interpretive communities; peripheral classifications openly contested; epsilon measurement hybrid (observational for mountains/ropes, constructed for snares/tangled_ropes)

axiom_contradictions.basis: Immutable diagnostic treats constraint types as discoverable through observation and falsifiable through better measurement; rhetorical scaffold treats constraint types as normative declarations whose validity derives from persuasive power. No single framework can hold both: either classification errors are correctable through better observation (diagnostic) or classification is irreducibly advocacy-dependent (scaffold). Accepting one axiom requires rejecting the other.

omegas.description: Is the framework's own classification as a contested kernel self-undermining? If rhetorical_scaffold_reading is correct, then treating the framework as a kernel contest is itself advocacy rather than diagnosis. If immutable_diagnostic_reading is correct, there must be an observable that adjudicates which reading is true—but no such observable is specified in the extraction.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium as Unexamined Axis)

omegas.description: Is this a kernel contest about Deferential Realism, or is it a meta-level kernel contest about how to recognize kernel contests? The framework's own kernel/reading decomposition protocol (§1.3-K) may itself be contested—different readers may disagree on whether the immutable/rhetorical split is a genuine kernel or a false dichotomy.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory—missing discussion of meta-level framework stability)

omegas.description: The immutable_diagnostic_reading claims constraint types are falsifiable through observation, but what observable would falsify a mountain classification? If no test is possible, the reading may collapse into rhetorical_scaffold_reading by default. Conversely, if inter-rater reliability data showed high consensus on snare classifications, rhetorical_scaffold_reading would be empirically weakened.
omegas.source: F03 (Hasty Generalization—mountain classification of immutable_diagnostic_reading ungrounded)

omegas.description: Rhetorical_scaffold_reading explicitly benefits policy_advocates, but immutable_diagnostic_reading has no listed beneficiary. Is this absence real (pure epistemic tool with no stakeholder), or is the absence itself a rhetorical move masking beneficiaries (e.g., academic authority, institutional legitimacy)? Asymmetry in beneficiary identification may signal interpretive bias.

Hybrid_pragmatic_reading stratifies the typology into empirical core (mountains/ropes) and interpretive periphery (snares/tangled_ropes), but where exactly is the boundary? Is a tangled_rope with high ε empirical or interpretive? The boundary itself may be a contested sub-kernel within the hybrid reading.
omegas.source: Pairwise Independence Test (hybrid reading may internally fracture)

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: immutable_diagnostic_reading classified as mountain (low ε, observer-independent) but the framework's own typology may not be falsifiable in the way the reading requires. No observable specified that would definitively adjudicate between immutable and rhetorical interpretations. Generated omega_empirical_test_availability to bound this uncertainty. Additionally, self-reference paradox flagged: analyzing the framework using the framework may introduce recursive instability.
